summary: Both the indicator and the weight are Q_j-invariant. (Line 83 is the `seal … in` prefix of the next declaration, which the line census attributes to this one; it is quoted in the step.)

steps.lean:
F.invWeight j x g := by simp [invWeight, indicator, h]

seal Finset.univ Finset.sum Finset.prod in
steps.claim: invWeight(F, j, x)(ξg) = 1[IsNear(F, j, ξg)]·floorWeight(F, j, ξg, x)⁻¹ and, for ξ ∈ Q_j, IsNear(F, j, ξg) ↔ IsNear(F, j, g) and floorWeight(F, j, ξg, x) = floorWeight(F, j, g, x) (both simp lemmas). Line 83, `seal Finset.univ Finset.sum Finset.prod in`, is a command prefix of the next declaration, not proof.
